facts.text: Fisk University's Jubilee Hall was constructed using funds raised by the Fisk Jubilee Singers and stands as the South's first permanent structure built for the education of Black students as well as a National Historic Landmark.

sources.title: Fisk University History
sources.quote: permitted construction of Jubilee Hall, the South's first permanent structure built for the education of black students.

sources.title: Fisk University History
sources.quote: As a designated National Historical Landmark, today, Jubilee Hall remains the dramatic focal point of Fisk's campus.
